strongest_angle: Cultural critic Chuck Klosterman publishes his 14th book, Rock*, presenting an alternate history where the Velvet Underground's 1967 debut album becomes the biggest-selling record in history while the Beatles fade into obscurity.

key_facts.fact: Cultural critic Chuck Klosterman authored his 14th book titled Rock*: A Mainstream Alternative History of Alternative Mainstream Music.
In the alternate history premise of Rock*, the 1967 album The Velvet Underground & Nico becomes the biggest-selling and most culturally influential record in history.
Within Chuck Klosterman's fictional universe, the Velvet Underground supplants the Beatles on the charts and in pop culture after the public spurns Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band.
